podcast.body: Released in 1971, this live album finally brought the band widespread attention, especially after their studio albums in 1969 and 1970 had largely gone unnoticed. For those who had already been attending their live performances, the album confirmed what they already knew about the band's powerful presence. The album featured an extended 22-minute live version of "Whipping Post," a significant increase from its 5-minute studio counterpart. "by 1971, the band releases live at Filmore East and now people pay attention."
